{{Quote|This unit needs to complete the sanitation of this garage bay, and then file its weekly report on the contents of the chamber. Please move aside, unfamiliar organic individual, so that this unit can finish its mandated tasks.|Toor|<ref name="Takeover at Whisper Base">{{FFG|story=Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beginner Game}}</ref>}}
'''BX-2R''', or '''Toor''', was a renovated [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] assigned to janitorial work at [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]]'s [[Whisper Base]]. Toor was fitted with a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] and was responsible for cleaning the garage and filing reports. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the droid encountered a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives trying to [[Takeover at Whisper Base|capture]] the base.

==Behind the scenes==
Toor appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure [[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base'']]. The players may free Toor, who will act as an ally, or otherwise incapacitate him.
